inputs.hmlr_local_authority: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham

acceptance_checks: The entry wrapper locates the raster guard and carrier in the slot-scoped repository paths
The entry wrapper executes the raster guard, parses its JSON receipt and requires PASS, version 1.0, eight checks and the exact official NoData sentinel before starting the carrier
The entry wrapper propagates the child carrier exit code without converting failure to success
All three network-capable Python components pass deterministic self-tests before network work
All six runtime source patches must match the pinned main Python source exactly once or execution stops
Fetch the current official HMLR download page using a cookie jar and require exactly one Barking and Dagenham row
Require the row link to equal the official London_Borough_of_Barking_and_Dagenham.zip route
Require HTTPS and allowlist the exact HMLR page path or the exact Barking and Dagenham S3 object path; PowerShell rechecks the receipt before handoff
Follow the short-lived official redirect without storing the signed query URL
Require ZIP magic, safe member paths, no encryption, no symlinks, bounded member count and bounded compression ratio
Require exactly one non-empty GML archive member and record separate ZIP and GML SHA-256 hashes
Require the extracted GML to read natively as EPSG:27700 with only valid non-empty positive-area Polygon or MultiPolygon geometries and plausible British National Grid bounds
Require one non-empty unique Land Registry-INSPIRE identifier per polygon and hash the sorted identifier set
Verify the persisted official page and GML byte counts and hashes before handing them to the measurement runner
For each of 11 points, query the official EA Composite 1m DTM survey-index OGC collection and hash the JSON response
Construct every primary metadata bbox from the canonical BNG point with a 5m margin and explicit EPSG:27700 bbox-crs
Request the primary metadata response geometry explicitly in EPSG:27700
Reject a primary metadata response whose final host, content type, Content-Crs or coordinate bounds conflict with the EPSG:27700 contract
Filter OGC BBOX candidates locally in BNG and require exactly one valid geometry intersecting the canonical point
Require filename, tilename, polygon_id, resolution, year, sd_flown, ed_flown, official response hash and selected-feature hash before resolving survey metadata
Parse four-digit survey years as calendar years, never Unix timestamps, and require consistency with survey start or end year
Query the official EA time-stamped DTM ArcGIS layer as secondary QA only and hash its response
Require the parcel DTM 10m service probe; record but do not block the terrain result when the DSM 10m QA probe is unavailable
A failed QA request for one parcel must not suppress factual receipts for the remaining parcels
Require classic TIFF byte-order and version headers II 42 or MM 42; reject BigTIFF and malformed headers
Filter both raster metadata NoData and the official EA WCS sentinel -3.4028235e38 before any min, max or percentile calculation
Fail closed when no finite non-NoData pixel remains after filtering
Bind each canonical EPSG:27700 point to exactly one current HMLR polygon; 15m proximity is candidate-only
Hash the exact polygon WKB, not only the containing GML file
Request and validate a full-polygon DTM raster as the required terrain evidence
Attempt a full-polygon DSM raster only as optional surface QA; DSM failure cannot substitute for or erase a valid DTM result
Require EPSG:27700, approximately 1m pixels, full polygon coverage and finite pixels
Compute terrain height difference only as polygon DTM maximum minus polygon DTM minimum and record robust p95-p05 QA
Require candidate provenance to include HMLR ZIP SHA-256, exact allowlisted ZIP final host and path, HMLR GML SHA-256, polygon WKB SHA-256 and DTM SHA-256
Withhold the business row until official Composite survey metadata passes strict source, collection, CRS, hash, resolution and date/year validation
Write factual fail-closed output and keep final_ready false for partial or blocked execution
Never count prepared or self-test-only rows as numeric parcel results
